floorplan_occupancy.method: Exact rectangle decomposition over top-level physical placement objects with module overlays used as semantic labels for a coarse floorplan map.

cell_array_mirror_audit.method: OpenRAM FreePDK45 bitcell placement mirror.x=True, mirror.y=False: alternate rows use MX while columns remain R0. When limited OpenYield storage aggregation is explicitly enabled, storage cells follow the configured row_orientation_policy while keeping peripheral arrays on the legacy path.

cell_array_layer_audit.method: Array occupancy audit: generic repeated cells must not overlap, while native OpenRAM storage cells may use designed boundary stitching at abstract bitcell pitch; external KLayout DRC remains the final legality check.

structural_audit.method: Structural consistency audit: storage cells must physically abut, column mux/precharge instances must match bitcell columns, BL/BR routes must align to real bitcell GDS pins, wordline row rails must cover every dummy/bitcell/replica row and physically intersect every storage WL pin access point, and compact logic/DFF rows must not contain avoidable internal gaps.

macro_replacement_audit.method: Replaceable peripheral macros are emitted only as physical OpenRAM/FreePDK45 GDS references. A future optimized decoder, wordline driver, mux, or control primitive can replace the GDS/SPICE behind the same named contract; missing physical macros are reported rather than drawn as fake cells.

gen_col_mux.replacement_contract: provide a FreePDK45-compatible GDS/SPICE pair with the same cell name, pin names from the pin model, and a measured bbox that fits this slot or update the macro dimensions in the registry

openram_cell_source_audit.method: All cells instantiated in the top GDS must be imported FreePDK45/OpenRAM GDS. Generated helper cells are accepted only when they are OpenRAM-extracted replacement macros; fallback rectangle-drawn stdcell geometry is not signoff-eligible.

cell_bbox_audit.method: OpenRAM-style dynamic GDS measurement: use the 239/text marker as logical placement pitch/origin when present, and keep the real drawn-geometry bbox for boundary and overhang audits.

hardcell_pin_access.source: GDS TEXT records from bundled hardcell libraries

generated_pin_access.source: generated stdcell pin model emitted as GDS TEXT records

connectivity_audit.method: bbox intersection between generated instances and top-level route/route_guide shapes

route_only_connectivity_audit.method: bbox intersection between generated instances and drawn top-level route shapes

generated_pin_route_audit.method: generated stdcell signal pin probe intersection with selected top-level geometry

generated_pin_route_or_guide_audit.method: generated stdcell signal pin probe intersection with selected top-level geometry

signoff_blockers: structural audit found loose abutment, unused column mux/precharge, or bitline misalignment
top-level route guides show intended connectivity but must be replaced by DRC-clean detailed routing
external signoff DRC/LVS/PEX has not been run; install KLayout/Magic/netgen or project signoff tools
SPICE netlist is structural; complete LVS equivalence must be proven with extracted netlist
